versions.name: Upload file to target host via scp
versions.description: Copy one file from the Buz workspace to a target host over SSH/SCP (engine: shell — runs on the Runner). Key-based auth only: the private key is a masked input written to a per-step temp file and removed afterwards. Prerequisites: ssh/scp on the Runner; the target's `authorized_keys` must trust the matching public key (config only — nothing is installed on the target).
versions.description_zh: 通过 SSH/SCP 将 Buz 工作区中的单个文件复制到目标主机(engine: shell,在 Runner 上执行)。仅支持密钥认证:私钥为 masked 输入,写入步骤级临时文件用后即删。前提:Runner 装有 ssh/scp;目标机 authorized_keys 信任对应公钥(仅配置,目标机不安装任何东西)。
versions.author: buz maintainers
